name: Lurker in the Dark

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Nightmarish Contortion
traits.summary: Fits into a 1-foot cube and through gaps 1 inch wide at no extra movement cost.
traits.text: The lurker can squeeze into a space as small as a 1-foot Cube, and pass through a gap only 1 inch wide without spending extra movement.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The lurker can climb difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits.name: Ward of Innocence
traits.summary: Can't attack, or willingly move within 10 ft of, a creature holding a stuffed animal once owned by a child.
traits.text: The lurker cannot attack a creature holding a stuffed animal that a child once owned, nor willingly move to a space within 10 feet of such a creature.

actions.name: Claw
actions.summary: +6, reach 10 ft, 1d10+4 Slashing; a Medium or smaller target is Grappled (escape DC 14) and Restrained until it escapes.

bonus_actions.name: Dark Teleport
bonus_actions.summary: Not in Bright Light: teleports up to 120 ft to an unoccupied space it can see (unseen if that space isn't in Bright Light either); a creature it grapples makes a DC 13 Cha save or goes with it.
bonus_actions.text: Usable only while the lurker is not in Bright Light. It teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space; if the destination is not in Bright Light it needn't see it. A creature the lurker is grappling must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or teleport with it to the nearest unoccupied space to the destination.

summary: A gaunt grey fey that squeezes through impossible gaps, seizes a victim with long clawed hands and teleports from dark to dark, dragging the prey along; a child's stuffed toy keeps it away.
